name: shravan-dev-workflow
description: Shravan's development workflow plugin with bounded design orchestration, goal orchestration, research, authoritative spec design, structural program design, independent spec/program review, user-requirements pathfinding, planning, implementation, debugging, operations, skill authoring, agent management, and structured TUI presentation.

interface.shortDescription: Spec/program design, review, planning, implementation, operations, agents, and TUI workflows
interface.longDescription: Use Shravan Dev Workflow to coordinate one bounded design cycle with orchestrator-design, define authoritative Why/What with spec-design, extract unwritten requirements and decisions with discuss-pathfinding, turn settled obligations into structural How with program-design, and independently review either artifact or their pair with spec-program-review before planning. The plugin also gathers source-grounded evidence, packages handoffs, creates and reviews implementation plans, executes plans, reviews implementations, finishes PRs, orchestrates goals and subordinate agents, investigates bugs, routes operations work, authors skills, maintains docs, and structures TUI explanations.
defaultPrompt: Run implementation-review-swarm on this change.
Prepare a plan handoff.
Prepare an implementation handoff.
Run plan-review-swarm on this plan.
Use spec-design to define the authoritative Why and What.
Use program-design to define structural How against this specification.
Use discuss-clarify-mental-models to rebuild the shared map before artifact work.
Use discuss-pathfinding to extract unwritten requirements or decisions before artifact work.
Use research-swarm to gather source-grounded evidence into a tmp ledger.
Use manage-agents to spawn, resume, monitor, or reduce subordinate agent work.
Use orchestrator-design to run this through one bounded specification, program-design, and pair-review cycle before planning.
Use orchestrator-goal to turn this into a verifiable long-horizon goal.
Use docs-maintain to reconcile these docs with current code and plans.
Use spec-program-review to independently review this specification and program design.
Use spec-handoff to package this design for another agent.
Use plan-creation-swarm to turn this current pair-reviewed specification and program design into an implementation plan.
Use plan-improve-repo to audit this repo and write executable improvement plans.
Use ops-security-review to choose the right Codex Security scan.
Use ops-observability-stack to prove local logs, metrics, and traces through the shared stack.
Run implementation-execute-plan on this plan.
Use implementation-pr-wrapup to finish this PR.
Investigate this bug before fixing it.
Use skills-creation to create, update, or evaluate one named skill.
Audit these skills against session evidence.
